key_highlights: ASX posts fourth consecutive losing week as rising bond yields pressure equities across sectors
RBA signals continued rate hikes despite a sharp unemployment jump, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD experiences a 'trapdoor' move, weakening sharply against USD amid divergent global policy
Australian house prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline; Victoria worst-hit state
Small-cap mining active: Anax Metals, Many Peaks, MinRex, Micro-X, Arrow Minerals, Mamba among weekly runners; $2.7B cap raise torrent pressures small-caps
Gold exploration strong: Aurum 155g/t hit, Zenith six-for-six in WA, Auric high-grade beyond Munda pit shell
Rio2 launches major drill assault at Peruvian copper mine; Vista Gold (VGZ) agrees to sale
Data centre boom flagged as potential energy supply risk for Australian grid
Star's Sydney casino licence remains suspended, weighing on gaming/consumer discretionary
Over half of Australian renters financially struggling; consumer stress intensifying

sectors.trend: Large-caps under pressure from rising bond yields and AUD weakness; small-cap gold and copper explorers showing strong assay results and cap raise activity. Rio2 Peruvian copper drill and multiple WA gold hits (Zenith, Auric, Aurum) signal continued exploration momentum.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVL.AX) and copper names (STO.AX, RIO.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows and commodity strength. Small-caps face dilution risk from $2.7B cap raise wave. BHP.AX, FMG.AX, RIO.AX pressured by yield-driven risk-off.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish stance despite unemployment spike supports net interest margins but raises credit-loss concerns. Rising bond yields compress bank equity valuations. Consumer stress (renters, housing) threatens loan book quality.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin tailwinds but credit headwinds. Rising yields pressure equity multiples. Monitor NPL trends as unemployment rises.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom flagged as energy supply risk; potential grid strain could support energy demand but raise infrastructure cost concerns. LNG and coal names mixed on global demand signals.
sectors.implications: SGP.AX, AGL.AX, WGE.AX may see demand tailwinds from data centres but face capex pressure. Woodside (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX) watch global energy pricing.

sectors.trend: Housing market in 40-year decline trajectory; Star casino licence suspended; consumer stress widespread. REITs pressured by rising yields and falling occupier confidence.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face yield compression and rental pressure. WES.AX, WOW.AX under consumer stress. Star Group (SGH.AX) hit by licence suspension.

sectors.trend: Medicare data breach prompts AI safety legislation calls. Global AI chip race (Nvidia, AMD, Intel) continues. CSL remains defensive anchor.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX (health) offer defensive positioning. Australian tech exposure limited; global AI capex cycle (headlines 64-70) supports sentiment but no direct ASX play.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot: rate hikes despite unemployment surge create stagflation risk
Bond yield rally pressuring all equity valuations; fourth straight ASX losing week
AUD trapdoor: currency weakness supports miners but signals capital outflows
Housing correction: 40-year high decline, Victoria worst-hit, renter stress at 50%+
Small-cap mining exploration boom vs. cap raise dilution risk
Energy infrastructure strain from data centre demand
Consumer credit stress: interest rate pincer squeezing households
Geopolitical risk: Ukraine-Russia escalation, US-China tensions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA continued hikes amid rising unemployment (stagflation)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive sectors (healthcare, staples); reduce leverage; monitor RBA statement for pivot signals
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) that benefit from weaker AUD

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market 40-year decline and credit losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight REITs and home-loan-heavy banks; monitor NAB.AX, ANZ.AX credit provisions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Rising bond yields compressing equity multiples
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shift duration; favour short-duration, high-earnings-yield names; consider bond ladders
Maintain gold allocation (GOLD.AX, NVL.AX); diversify geographically

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Small-cap dilution from $2.7B cap raise wave
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid speculative small-caps; focus on well-funded explorers with clear milestones

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners and explorers on safe-haven and AUD weakness
opportunities.rationale: 155g/t Aurum hit, Zenith six-for-six WA, Auric Munda extension; AUD trapdoor boosts AUD-denominated gold revenue; geopolitical risk premium

opportunities.recommendation: Add copper exposure via Rio2 and major miners on drill momentum
opportunities.rationale: Rio2 Peruvian drill assault signals copper supply expansion; structural demand from electrification and data centres

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Stagflation risk and consumer stress favour essential-spending sectors; CSL remains quality compounder

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property exposure; underweight housing-linked banks
defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year house price decline trajectory, renter stress at 50%+, rising yields compress REIT valuations and raise credit risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity portfolio with short-duration bonds and gold
defensive_moves.rationale: Fourth straight ASX losing week on yield rally; bond-yield-driven selloff may persist; gold hedges AUD weakness and geopolitical risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid speculative small-caps amid $2.7B cap raise dilution
defensive_moves.rationale: Dilution risk elevated; focus only on well-funded names with clear drill/assay catalysts

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1-3 month window. Rising bond yields, RBA hawkishness, and AUD weakness create headwinds. Fourth consecutive losing week suggests momentum is negative. Expect volatility around RBA decisions and US policy signals. Gold and copper miners outperform; REITs and consumer discretionary lag.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Stagflation risk (hiking rates + rising unemployment) is the dominant scenario. Housing correction may deepen, pressuring bank credit and construction. However, commodity strength (gold, copper) and AUD weakness support mining majors. A RBA pivot on unemployment data could trigger a relief rally. Structural themes: data centre energy demand, AI infrastructure, and resource exploration remain positive.
